I will do this plot the way I know and the way people around me do when money is tight. This plot is small, and I intercrop it, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it; I will put some farmyard manure if I can gather enough from home and I will plant my saved local seed. For spray, I will use a little pesticide if insects come badly on the beans, but I will not irrigate because I wait for the rains.
